footer.tagline: Password manager and digital secrets vault built for professionals and organizations across Africa.
footer.slogan: Protect your access. Own your secrets.

legal.cgu1p: These terms govern the use of DencPass, a password and digital secrets manager, available at app.dencpass.com. By creating an account, you accept these terms in full.
legal.cgu2p: DencPass is available to individuals (Community / Pro editions) and organizations (Enterprise SaaS edition). Enterprise SaaS access requires a valid license issued by DencPass.
legal.cgu3p: You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential, for the accuracy of the data you enter, and for the security of your device. DencPass cannot be held liable for a compromise resulting from user negligence.
legal.cgu4p: Your passwords, secrets and certificates are encrypted before being stored. DencPass has no access to your sensitive data in clear text.
legal.cgu5p: You can delete your account at any time from Settings → Danger zone. For organizations, termination takes effect when the license expires, after a 7-day grace period.
legal.cgu6p: DencPass reserves the right to modify these terms. Users will be notified by email at least 15 days before any material change.
legal.privacy1p: DencPass collects: email address, username, connection metadata (date, IP), and the encrypted data you store. No sensitive data is readable by our teams.
legal.privacy2p: Your data is used exclusively to provide the DencPass service: authentication, secure storage, and certificate/license expiration notifications.
legal.privacy3p: Data is deleted immediately when the account is closed. Security logs are kept until manually rotated by the administrator.
legal.privacy4p: DencPass does not sell, rent, or share any personal data with third parties for commercial purposes.
legal.privacy5p: Right of access, rectification, deletion and portability. To exercise these rights: support@dencpass.com
legal.privacy6p: Multi-key encryption, 2FA authentication, access logging, strict access control on our servers.
